provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender 5.2.3 LTS, dark high fantasy with a PS1 look: a roofless crypt hall of cold basalt ashlar with reliquary alcoves, sarcophagi, chains and the Waystone, lit by a single cold-blue accent (the colour the finale already uses for its text); all textures and geometry procedural; no third-party, kit, AI-service or downloaded content

recipe.method: Near architecture that enters the camera sight volume (so it can come between camera and board), exported as a separate mesh for dither fade: the back wall with the Waystone apse and dais, the declining side walls, pilasters, reliquary alcoves, corbel stubs, hanging chains, the front-corner sarcophagus rows and the collapsed rib; never within 1.5 m of any camera eye. LOD1 only: sharp-edge vertices are pinned, so a collapse stops at about 54 % and LOD2 would equal LOD1
recipe.approved_reference: Gate 1 decision on #140 (2026-11-08); #145 r002 standard; parent #138

parameters.units: metres, 1 cell = 1.50 m, footprint 18 x 12 cells = 27 x 18 m centred on the origin (the 16 x 11 board sits inside it)
parameters.material: one baseColor atlas 2048x2048 plus COLOR_0 RGBA (A = glow mask on the cold-blue rune and crystal materials, 0 elsewhere)
parameters.sampling: Linear (trilinear + mips) with 16 px wrapped padding per atlas region
parameters.pivot: origin = board centre at floor level; place at identity together with SM_World_Vault
parameters.clear_volume_rule: Camera clear volume (camera_volume.py): SIGHT VOLUME = convex hull of the footprint (+ half-cell margin, lifted 12 cm) and every camera eye of the #143 pose law (framed 1400-4600, zoom 900-6400, pitch 35/45/60, 36 yaws) plus the lead envelope (reach 55 m, height 66 m); the world shell keeps 1.0 m outside it except ground within 12 cm of the floor; meshes that enter it are the occluders. EYE SPACE = every eye, 1.5 m sphere: no mesh contains or approaches an eye.

lods.tool: Blender collapse decimator, UV-island seams kept, 16-bit COLOR_0 and atlas unchanged, extreme vertices pinned

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed reimport (#149 phase 2, as #145)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: explicit LOD1 (about 50 %) and LOD2 (about 25 %, up to 40 % where the silhouette needs it) imported from <name>_LOD1.glb and <name>_LOD2.glb beside the LOD0 export
settings.collision: none (presentation only; blocking comes from gameplay data)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB light, A glow mask)
settings.axes: metres, +X forward, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
